content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The Kubient MSA contains no minimum purchase commitment, volume floor, take-or-pay obligation or shortfall/penalty mechanic binding AP:

- **§5 Fees and Payment** is a pure revenue share on revenue actually generated; payment flows from Kubient to AP (sequential liability), with AP responsible only for applicable taxes.
- **§1** limits Services to those AP specifically engages under individual Exhibits — i.e., ordered Services only.
- The only "minimum" references are the Winning Bid Price floor in §3(j) (a protection in AP's favour) and the §13 acknowledgement that no minimum revenue is guaranteed — neither imposes a commitment on AP.
- No usage/volume caps; §6(a) restrictions are use-type restrictions, not volume limits.
- AP additionally has a 90-day exit for any reason after the one-year Initial Term, so even a future Exhibit commitment would be bounded.

No redline proposed. Note for diligence: any future Exhibit should be reviewed for minimum-impression or minimum-spend floors, since the commercial terms are pushed to Exhibits.
